persons.name: Cakrarāja
persons.evidence: vibudhaś cakrarājaḥ sudhīraḥ śukle pakṣe vividharacanaṃ lekhayāmāsa kena

date.as_written: kāle dyocāraṇavikalite, śuddhanepālaśāke, māghe māse śaśadharadine, śrīpañcamyāṃ śukle pakṣe

notes: The chronogram 'dyocāraṇavikalite' is interpreted as 906 (dyo=0, cāraṇa=6?, vikalite=9?) or similar, matching the catalogue's SAM (NS) 906. 'śaśadharadine' means Monday (day of the moon). The scribe's name is Cakrarāja.
